entries.subject: SDSS DR9 color HiPS
entries.finding: An 1800 x 1800 px hips2fits cutout of CDS/P/SDSS9/color, 8.0 arcmin wide on the 2MASS position. The core does not saturate (peak 219 of 255) and the light reaches the sky level about 240 arcsec out.

entries.subject: DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys DR10 color HiPS
entries.finding: Baked first, on 2026-10-02, and replaced. The composite saturates within about 20 arcsec of the core, so sight lines through the centre carried less light than the cusp of the fit gives them: from the side and from above the volume showed a dark band through the core between two bright lobes, and green and pink rings in the halo.

entries.subject: Catalogues for the masks
entries.finding: HyperLEDA PGC alone left galaxies it lists without a D25 in the image; the 2MASS Extended Source Catalog sizes them. NOX leaves the haloes of bright stars, so Gaia DR3 stars brighter than G = 15 are masked too. At M87's three D25 radii a close neighbour's mask covers NGC 4889's own centre, so each mask stops at half its distance from the centre.

entries.subject: Spheroid
entries.finding: Dullo (2019), Table 3, row NGC 4889: core-Sérsic n = 13.3, R_e = 563.9 arcsec, one component, from an optical profile that reaches large radii. Used as published without its core; no fit was made here.

entries.subject: Savorgnan & Graham (2016) fit, as tabulated by Sahu et al. (2020)
entries.finding: Sahu, Graham & Davis (2020), Table A1, row 33, give n_maj = 8.10, R_e,maj = 119.70 arcsec from the Spitzer 3.6 micron image. It disagrees with Dullo's optical fit by a factor of 4.7 in radius. Dullo's is used because it is fitted to optical light like the image; the choice barely changes the depth inside 240 arcsec, where both are steep cusps.
